svg.title: Gate readiness
svg.desc: Gate readiness for G0 to G6. Next gate G0 Governance: 0 of 21 work products approved, 0 of 2 confirmation measures performed, 0 of 3 interfaces agreed, 2 roles unassigned.
svg.text: What each gate still needs before it can be reviewed, read from the generated gate skeletons (10-safety-case/gates/skeletons), which the process model writes from WP-M-00, WP-M-02, WP-M-06 and the IFR items.
IFR items, agreed by recorded review
What stands between now and G0 Governance
Work products to review and approve (21)
Plus 91 open items in those work products. A gate passes only through a recorded review in 10-safety-case/gates/; this board is the skeletons' view, not that review.

g.text: Terms: AUD-nn functional safety audit, AUD-n (WP-M-06 §5) · CR-nn confirmation review of the confirmation measures plan (WP-M-06) · FSA-F final functional safety assessment at G5 (WP-M-06 §6) · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project lifecycle; in the safety case, a claim G0, G1, G1.1…

(WP-K-01) · HW hardware · IFR interface record (trace/items/ifr.yaml): a cross-domain interface, agreed only by a recorded review · IFR-nn interface record IFR-nn: one cross-domain interface with its owners, open item and agreement state (trace/items/ifr.yaml) · SR-nn independent

SOTIF or AI evaluation review, SR-nn (WP-M-06 §7) · SW software · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
